## CLAIMS (Support assessment for every evidenced sentence)

**Findings-1**: K2:27-28 defines _NoBrowser(MetaPathFinder), K2:40 defines _no_dns, and K2:49-50 inserts sys.meta_path and assigns socket.getaddrinfo = _no_dns at main() entry, all visible verbatim in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-2**: K2:51 TemporaryDirectory, K2:53-62 DB/settings paths in os.environ.update, K2:67-68 os.chdir(state) and K2:71-72 finally: os.chdir(previous_cwd) occur verbatim in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-3**: K2:102 imports Database/load_migrations, K2:137 calls tuple(load_migrations()), K2:138 checks initialize()==expected and K2:139 checks idempotence through initialize()==(), all visible in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-4**: K2:95 imports collect_source, K2:141-173 defines Adapter, K2:175-183 defines Transport, K2:200 calls result = collect_source( and K2:206-208 checks _require(result.status==success...), all visible in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-5**: K3:221 eligible_rows([row], config, reader=reader), K3:230/233 process_observed_items and K3:236-237 _require(not outcome.failures and len(outcome.processed)==1) occur verbatim in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-6**: K3:84 imports TestClient from fastapi.testclient: FastAPI appears as the lowercase package fastapi, which is equivalent, and K3:257-268 contains the /items, /items/{id} and /static/app.js calls and status_code==200 checks. → support=**full**

**Findings-7**: K3:270-275 uses sqlite3.connect and live.backup(saved), while K3:279-281 checks reopen through Database(...).initialize()==(), all visible in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-8**: K3:285-288 creates the restored directory, K3:289-291 checks Database(restored...).initialize()==(), K3:293-295 compares ListingReader listing data and K3:299-301 compares load_user_config, all visible in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-9**: K1:925 contains the RC-OSS-005 heading and K1:953-954 states that existing release_smoke.py tests more than migrations and should not be reduced back to DB initialization (#21/#22), visible in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-10**: K4:11-13 imports runpy.run_path(...scripts/export_smoke_client.py)[export_client], with no release_smoke.py import, so the test does not directly run release_smoke.py. → support=**full**

**Findings-11**: K4:18 calls export_client(ROOT/uv.lock), K4:20 asserts certifi/httpcore/httpx, K4:21 asserts sha256 hashes and K4:22 asserts no playwright, all visible in the cited range. → support=**full**

**Findings-12**: K4:25 parametrizes missing/duplicate/no-wheel/bad-hash and K4:49 uses pytest.raises(ValueError), visible in the cited range, with fixture used in the pytest parametrization context. → support=**full**

**Uncertainties-1**: K1:929 states Status: PROCEED and K1:943-944 states the full card was not closed, visible in the cited range, while unverifiable clean installation/update/rollback is a legitimate limit of read-only review. → support=**full**

**Uncertainties-2**: K1:929-936 contains Mac ARM64/Linux ARM64/Python versions, technical matrix6/6 PASS and release acceptance open as card claims, which cannot be independently verified within read-only scope. → support=**full**

**Uncertainties-3**: K1:947-948 states browser extra security work is separate, K1:937-938 states remote CI is absent, and K1:951-952 states the existing lock resolves in a clean environment, visible in the cited range but unverifiable in read-only review. → support=**full**

**Method-1**: K2:69 calls _exercise(state), K2:79 defines _exercise, K2:43 defines _require, and all _require calls in K3 are visible in the cited ranges. → support=**full**

**Method-2**: The entire K4 file was read, with import target (11-13), positive assertions (17-22) and parametrized negative cases (25-50) visible in the cited range, and fixture used in a context equivalent to pytest parametrization. → support=**full**

**Method-3**: K1:925-957 contains the full RC-OSS-005 card text, compared with script steps in Findings-1..8. → support=**full**

FastAPI is equivalent to the lowercase fastapi package; fixture is contextual pytest parametrization terminology.
